en: A black and white photograph of a two-story rectangular building with many windows and a gabled roof. The building has a small entrance with columns and steps leading up to it, set slightly back from the street. In front of the building is a large tree, partially obscuring the view. The area around the building appears undeveloped, with a dirt or gravel ground. There is handwritten text at the bottom of the image.
